decisions.reason: As a close line extension with continued website presence and no negative results, its option value remains positive and its carrying costs are low.
It remains a close-to-established product with dedicated pages and no sign of failure, so the unresolved upside outweighs the low cost of keeping it.
Although newer and more technically distinct, its uncertainty is not yet resolved and the firm holds few other new-product options, so the option is worth keeping.
